metadata.title: Vintage Mid-Century Still Life Album Cover

recipe.visualDefinition: A 1960s-style album cover featuring a central still life photograph of a clear wine bottle, a glass of red wine, a crusty baguette, and a block of cheese against a neutral, slightly textured off-white background. The top third is a solid black header containing bold, heavy sans-serif typography with distinct drop shadows.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical bottle acts as the central axis for the composition
Horizontal alignment of bread and cheese anchors the bottom of the frame
Contrast between the dark header and the light photographic field
Color coordination between the red wine and the pink/red typography
coreInvariants: Heavy drop shadows on display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central still life occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame; subjects are life-sized relative to the square format.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The tall, slender wine bottle in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bold text in the black header, moves down the bottle to the bread and cheese, then circles back through the wine glass.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample off-white space surrounding the still life objects to create a clean, mid-century modern feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, earthy tones in the photograph contrasted with high-saturation, high-value text colors.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a warm, analog film palette

letterConstructionRules: Hard, blocky drop shadows offset to the bottom right

typesetting.alignment: Left and Right justified within header

treatment.shadow: Hard black or dark red drop shadow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrasting colors (Pink vs Green) using the same font weight and style for visual unity.
graphicDevices: Thin green rectangular border for metadata text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, mid-century sans-serif look.
Provides the necessary weight and period-accurate feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a clear wine bottle, a glass of red wine, a crusty baguette, and a block of cheese on a white surface against a light grey wall. The top 25% of the image is a solid black rectangle. Analog film grain and warm lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed sans-serif text in the black header. Use pink for the left side and lime green for the right side. Apply a hard, dark drop shadow to all text. Add a small green boxed label at the very top center.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a distinct, hard drop shadow?
Is the photography style reminiscent of 1960s film?
Are the colors muted in the photo but vibrant in the text?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure drop shadows are consistent in direction
Verify the black header is a clean geometric block
Confirm the wine color looks natural and not neon
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Subject] still life with a [Color] header bar and [Heavy Condensed Sans-Serif] typography featuring [Hard Drop Shadows] to create a [1960s] aesthetic.
